changes.change: Explicit OmicStat CLI/module/arg spec/StudyContract, typed candidate handoff, OS error namespace, suite finish/provenance, independent shared renderer; no MedStat runtime/filesystem/environment or clinical journal/report layer.

Twenty-one copied numerical/input/flow helpers plus .da_stop and twenty-four QC/assembly helpers. Scientific estimator bodies retained with exception/QC namespace mapping. COPIED_FUNCTIONS lists exact normalized source/target hashes.

Explicit subject-wide feature_table or selected expression_matrix with separately declared binary sample sheet, ID-key alignment, exact same paired complete-case sets, actual independent-unit declaration. Reject repeated IDs, nonfinite/mislabeled input, corrected/display-only lineage and changed contracts before inference.

P0-13 A row3 explicitly requires DeLong and explicit correction for multiple biomarkers. Preserve original primary-versus-rest comparisons and raw P; require caller-selected p.adjust method and complete family size. Difference CIs remain unadjusted pointwise. No default or all-pairs expansion introduced.

Original out-of-bag loop min(boot_n,200) remains literal. Record requested/attempted/successful/failed counts. Preserve per-resample means and percentile intervals; no pooling into pseudo-independent counts or increase in cap.

Every optimized cutoff and resulting apparent accuracy is labelled exploratory. Keep original first-best point tie and native ci.coords tie failure. Full LOO predictions required. Original internal-validation=none override remains visible as unresolved high QC; missing/failed cutoff CI never silently replaced.

Finite DeLong variance requires at least two independent observations in each class; LOO requires at least three per class so every training fold retains at least two. LOO above 10000 units refuses with OS_RESOURCE_LIMIT and no automatic subsampling or method switch; this is an explicit implementation bound, not a new scientific estimator.

Original overlapping missing-index and missing-reference counts could double-count the same row. New disjoint exclusion priority records indeterminate exclusion then missing index then missing reference. Without a cutoff, two confusion-count identities are explicitly not applicable, never fabricated.

Explicit confidence level, accuracy CI method, class/direction and bootstrap count; no inferred scientific recommendation. Optional projection only runs on a supplied assumed prevalence grid. Multiple thresholds currently require a primary cutoff. Independent JSON labels replace original report YAML/label merge.

Parameterize original hardcoded 95-percent cutoff-instability text. Clarify negative J is mathematically possible while retaining source review warning. Multiplicity guard now enforces the plan-required selected adjustment. Original MedStat prose scanning/report layout is not copied.

Move original ROC coordinates/ci.se grid 0.02/seeded bootstrap from graphics into compute. Shared display-only primary/comparison/partial-region ROC consumes aggregate source tables with dataset labels and typed intervals/statistics; private input IDs and rows are not figure sources. Original score-distribution/participant-flow diagrams remain pending, checked flow table retained.

Bind all numerical tables to actual native-source estimand SHA256 and immutable table hashes, compare native AUC/counts before finish/render. Undefined native comparison variance stays undefined. No clipping of observed AUC/J, manufactured uncertainty or method substitute.

Original synthetic counted-2x2 four anchors plus nine independent/source-adapter checks are definitions awaiting native R4.6.1. Official aSAH package/data version and SHA256 unbound; owner_review absent, no fabricated receipt or uploaded clinical rows.
